sandbachFocus: Sandbach United host Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00, looking to bounce back from their most recent loss. The league leaders sit first with 22 points from 10 games and will be strong favourites against bottom-club Alsager, who have won just once all season. Sandbach then travel to face Cheadle Heath Nomads on Saturday 10 October at 15:00, in what should be another winnable fixture against a struggling side near the foot of the table.
divisionWide: The opening day of this fixture batch on Saturday 3 October sees several key matches. Stafford Town, in second place on 20 points, travel to Dawley Town as they chase Sandbach's lead. In-form Bilston Town host Foley Meir, while high-flying Wolverhampton Casuals (4th, 19 points) visit Wednesfield Community. AFC Bridgnorth, 3rd on 19 points, face Eccleshall at home. Allscott Heath claim they are chasing five wins on the bounce as they travel to Crewe, though their table position (11th, 11 points) suggests some inconsistency. Brereton Social (14th, 11 points) host Widnes Town, who sit rock-bottom with just 2 points from 7 games. Shawbury United visit Barnton in a clash between mid-table teams, while New Mills travel to Market Drayton Town and Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Sandbach. On Wednesday 7 October, Brereton Social host Wednesfield Community. The following Saturday 10 October features further fixtures: Telford Town visit New Mills, Stafford Town host Wednesfield Community, Bilston Town entertain Crewe, Barnton face Dawley Town, Market Drayton host Widnes Town, and Alsager Town visit Shawbury United.
